summary.text: Ijebu kept the roads from Lagos to the interior closed to free trade and missionaries. In May 1892 a Lagos Colony force with Maxim guns marched in, defeated the Ijebu army at Imagbon and occupied Ijebu-Ode.

moments.title: Imagbon
moments.text: The Ijebu army is defeated at the crossing of the Yemoji river.

moments.title: Ijebu-Ode occupied
moments.text: The capital is occupied and the roads opened to Lagos trade.
